historical_references.reference: Asadul Khan was a prominent Bengali Muslim ruler during the late medieval period. He was the founder of the independent Bengal Sultanate in 1204 AD, marking the end of the Hindu Pala Empire in Bengal.
historical_references.context: End of the Hindu Pala Empire and founding of the independent Bengal Sultanate

historical_references.reference: Asadul Khan was also known as 'Raja Ganesha' during his reign in Bengal, and is believed to have adopted Hindu practices and even assumed a Hindu name, Ganesha, to strengthen his position among the Hindu population.
historical_references.context: Adoption of Hindu name and practices to strengthen political position
